hypothesis: A frozen 48-circuit exact-truth suite (post-pivot: peaked endpoint 403-denied, pauli-path window degenerate; 48 local RCS n in {20,24,26} x d in {4,8,12,16} x 4 seeds, split 24/12/12 by seeded permutation) with a physically locked holdout supports an adversarial flywheel whose every accept/reject decision is auditable and holdout-uncontaminated.

predictions.freeze_one_shot: suite/MANIFEST.json written once with suite_sha256; second freeze attempt refused
predictions.holdout_locked: suite/holdout readable only via src/holdout_eval.py, exactly once per campaign
predictions.counts: train 24 / val 12 / holdout 12 over all 48 circuits
predictions.per_cell: each (n,d) cell has 4 circuits; splits are NOT stratified (pure seeded permutation) — recorded, not enforced
predictions.truth_runtime: 48 exact statevector computations complete locally in under ~60 min (3 workers)

acceptance_metric: mean per-circuit normalized XEB over the 12 val circuits, paired per-circuit vs the incumbent; cost = sum of (queue_time_ms + run_time_ms)/60000 over the val jobs
score_definition: xeb_normalized = raw_linear_xeb / (2^n * sum(p_exact^2) - 1); exact sampler -> 1, uniform -> 0; mps.cpu count keys bit-un-reversed (canonical_counts) before scoring
